properties.name: samd:why-hand-maintained
properties.value: The generated CycloneDX SBOM is scoped to the :app releaseRuntimeClasspath. Neither the model weights (they are files under app/src/main/assets/, not a Gradle dependency) nor the sherpa-onnx AAR (a file dependency under app/libs/, since com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx publishes nothing to Maven Central) nor ONNX Runtime (native libraries carried inside that AAR) appear in a resolved dependency graph. The single most safety-relevant SOUP this release introduces is invisible to the mechanism that exists to record SOUP. This file is that gap closed by hand. See docs/sbom/README.md.

properties.name: samd:change-control
properties.value: Every component below is compiled into the APK and changes only by shipping a new app release. That makes a model change a design change under normal change control, not a post-deployment model update, so it does not engage the Algorithm Change Protocol gap recorded in docs/quality/qms-overview.md. The property holds only while there is no other update path: no download-on-first-use, no model CDN, no silent refresh, no remote config selecting a model. Any of those would reopen the ACP question and the off-device-egress question in one move.

properties.name: samd:runtime-verification
properties.value: SherpaOnnxTranscriptionServiceTest asserts these SHA-256 values against the bytes actually shipped in the APK, on-device (emulator or physical). Not a CI gate: the weights are stored local-only (see samd:storage above), so CI has nothing to hash.

technicalLimitations: Trained on English only. Predominantly read and US/Western-accented speech (nvidia/Granary, nvidia/nemo-asr-set-3.0).

NOT evaluated on Indian-accented English, and NOT evaluated on spontaneous clinical narrative. The deployment is a rural PHC in India. No accuracy figure is claimed anywhere in this release and none should be quoted from the upstream model card, which measures a different population.
An accented-speech evaluation set is outstanding and is a precondition of exposing this to a user, not a follow-up to it.
ethicalConsiderations: Every transcript reaches the record only through the confirmation gate: it is shown as a suggestion, never written to the field until a worker confirms it. A wrong transcription is therefore a legibility problem in front of a human, not a silent data corruption. That is the control that makes an un-evaluated accent profile tolerable at all, and it is why partial hypotheses are not surfaced during capture.

components.name: tokens.txt
components.description: SentencePiece vocabulary, 1025 entries, paired with the encoder above.

properties.name: samd:why-pinned-separately
properties.value: Not folded into the model entry, deliberately. A mismatched vocabulary does not raise an error: it produces fluent, plausible, wrong text. That is 9384 bytes whose corruption is silent and whose failure mode is exactly the hazard the confirmation gate exists to catch, so it gets its own line and its own hash.

components.name: parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 training corpus provenance
components.description: Provenance record. Not shipped, not a file in the APK. Recorded because the weights are a derived work of these corpora and because the licence obligation below travels with them.

properties.name: samd:training-data
properties.value: nvidia/Granary and nvidia/nemo-asr-set-3.0, English.

properties.name: samd:attribution-obligation
properties.value: CC-BY-4.0 requires attribution of the model to NVIDIA wherever the derived work is distributed. The app distributes the weights inside the APK from the moment this PR merges to a release branch — the obligation attaches at APK distribution, not at the flag flip, since VOICE_FIELD_IMPACT_ENABLED = false hides the feature but does not remove the bundled weights. This is a BLOCKER on any release build that includes this change, not merely on the flag flip. PROPOSED placement: the app's open-source licences screen, naming 'NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 (CC BY 4.0)' with a link to https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2. NOT IMPLEMENTED in this change: no such screen exists anywhere in this app today (verified — none of SettingsScreen/AboutScreen/NOTICE/licences infrastructure is present), so adding the attribution is not a one-line edit to an existing screen but a new UI surface, which is out of scope for an ASR-engine swap. Operator must either (a) build that screen before this ships in a release build, or (b) discharge the obligation some other way (a NOTICE file bundled in the APK, for instance) before release. This is not discharged by this SOUP record alone.

properties.name: samd:not-an-omission
properties.value: There is deliberately no entry for the platform speech recognizer. It was deleted in this change and it could never have had a row here: its version is whatever the handset happens to ship, so it cannot be pinned, cannot be hashed and cannot be validated. Shipping a component that cannot be given a row is the thing this discipline exists to prevent.
